meters.label: Codex monthly allowance
meters.hint: Enter by hand. The Codex collector doesn't read this window yet.

reset.rule: Resets monthly. OpenAI doesn't say whether it follows your billing date. Settings → Usage shows the reset time.
stipulations: OpenAI doesn't publish the size. It's meant for lightweight coding tasks.
Codex on Go runs GPT-6 Luna at Standard speed in the desktop app, subject to rollout.
Codex cloud tasks aren't included on Go.

resets.label: Banked Codex resets

count.rule: Given out in OpenAI promotions, including some referral offers. The usage API reports how many you hold.

resets.howTo: Desktop app: Settings → Usage & billing, select the reset and confirm. CLI: /usage, then Redeem reset.
stipulations: Free. Each reset has its own expiry date, shown in your account or the offer.
On Go it restores the monthly allowance to 100%.
You can only use one when the allowance has less than 80% left.
Unused or expired resets aren't refunded or replaced.

overage: At the limit, wait for the monthly reset or upgrade. Credit purchases are open only to a limited group of Go users. Paid instant resets aren't available on Go.

how: A low-cost plan above Free. Unlimited everyday text chats, subject to abuse guardrails.
Codex is for lightweight tasks: GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app, with a monthly allowance.
Includes Think, which uses GPT-5.6 Luna. GPT-5.6 Sol and legacy models aren't included.
ext: API usage isn't included and is billed separately.
quirks: Ads are being tested with eligible Go users in some regions.
Billed monthly only. There's no annual option.
Switching from Plus or Pro to Go takes effect at the end of the billing cycle, with no refund.
The Codex usage API calls this plan "go".
